column1: # Build llvm-min-tblgen inside the guest (`.notes/toolchain_in_os.md` Phase 4).
# This is the first of two boots. It compiles every source of
# cross-built `libLLVMTableGen.a` and `libLLVMSupport.a`, and leaves the binary
# on the disk. `tools/smoke/tblgen-run.tsv` runs it in the second boot.
# Two include paths are needed: the source side of `utils/TableGen` for
# `Basic/...` headers, and the staged LLVM include tree for `llvm/ADT/...`. The
# archives are built `-fno-rtti` (`LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI` is off), so the guest units
# take it too; without it a class with a virtual base emits a typeinfo reference
# the archive does not define. The archives are also built `NDEBUG`.
# Each source is its own step so a compile failure names the file, and every
# object is checked before the link. The line buffer in the shell is 256 bytes,
# which is why no line below lists more than one source and the link takes its
# The final `sync` is what lets the second boot run a binary this boot wrote.
